name: hackyguru-modules
description: Logos Basecamp modules by Guru (hackyguru) — Persona (private LEZ wallet + Bedrock base-chain node), Chorus (serverless voice rooms), LEZ Counter and LEZ Guestbook (shared on-chain apps on the LEZ testnet), Beacon (serverless live streaming from OBS), and Field Pay (public and private token payments on LEZ), with more on the way.
